calls.base_case: Revenue $64.2bn, up 26% YoY; ad impressions +10% with higher price per ad and engagement, delivered with 12% fewer employees; Q4 revenue guided to about $74.5bn at the midpoint.

calls.thesis: BUY reiterated (most recent prior explicit was BUY; no flip) — title frames his favorites as a screaming buy. Meta still undervalued after an amazing quarter: revenue +26% to $64B, ad impressions +10%, price per ad +14%, daily active people +3%, and Muse personal-agent traction (10M set up in ~6 weeks). Says if the stock goes lower he will pick up more shares; the -5% flip from green to red is an opportunity, not a broken business.
